name: au-employee-share-schemes
description: Use this guide for Australian employee share scheme (ESS) work under Division 83A of the ITAA 1997 in the 2026-27 income year: resident individual employees who receive discounted shares, rights, options or RSUs, and the companies that report them. Covers the upfront taxing point and $1,000 reduction, deferral and the deferred taxing point, the 30-day rule, the start-up concession, forfeiture, ESS statements and TFN withholding, and the boundary with CGT on later disposal. Trigger on 'ESS', 'employee share scheme', 'RSU vesting', 'employee options', 'ESS statement', 'start-up concession', 'deferred taxing point' or 'Division 83A'.
